name: placement
kind: installation, supersedes version 1 (first replay: K1, K3, K6, K7 failed; see its last addendum); frozen before any replay of an engine or converter with the amended rules. Rules S, T, D, M, F, their leaf fields and the mapping are those of version 1 with its addenda, word for word. Rule B and rule P are amended; criteria K2-K7 are those of version 1 word for word; K1 is restated after its data was seen (stated below)
why: placement_basic v1 addendum, branch_basic v1 addendum, sync_basic v4 / v5 addenda and the per-pc tables of the 161 + 47 + 21 + 28 probe cells per device: the hardware books these waits on other pcs than the replay with the time about right. Probe scoreboard of the current replay (loop scope, engine / reference floor): pc x class error 0.482 / 0.101 (h100), 0.461 / 0.096 (b300).
data_seen_before_freezing: Everything listed in version 1 and its addenda.

The version 1 replay placement-v1r1 (build 8e584d9c), H100 verdicts and the per-cell scoreboard of branch_basic-v quoted in version 1's last addendum; show_cell listings of v.yield1.w8 and v.yield1.s1. B300's replay of version 1 was not looked at.
No replay with the amended rules B and P.

The restated K1 (ii) was computed on the version 1 replay before this file was committed (S and T are unchanged, so its outcome is known): 56 of 56 taken back-edges within the bounds on H100; on the 370bf919 replay 0 of 56. It therefore confirms an implementation already seen to work and is not an independent test; the independent checks of this version are K3 (rule B) and K6 / K7 (rule P).

rules.B (amended): As version 1 with Dmin = 5 and UMOV not a pass kind, except how the form is known: the converter marks a BAR template whose static opcode text carries the modifier DEFER_BLOCKING with a template flag (a fact of the static instruction; the operation class stays BAR, no leaf lookup changes), and rule B applies to cta_barrier intervals armed by an instance of a marked template. Unmarked BAR templates: unchanged.
rules.P (amended): As version 1 with its addenda, plus: the records kept behind the surviving poll through its reader come from an attempt in which the poll failed; they execute as the poll's success implies. A kept record guarded by the poll's destination predicate P<n>: guard @P<n> -> its execution mask is the surviving poll's execution mask; guard @!P<n> -> empty execution mask (the instance stays in the stream predicated off: it issues and waits for the barriers in its wait mask, nothing else). Unguarded records and records guarded by another predicate keep their own record.

criteria.K1 (S, T): RESTATED AFTER THE VERSION 1 REPLAY WAS SEEN (version 1's clause `branch_basic-v below 0.250` failed at 0.2622 and stays failed there; it is replaced because it measured a source whose error is mostly behind YIELDs, outside S and T, and is reported below instead). (i) unchanged: mean pc x class error of mio_basic-r3 below 0.150 on both devices. (ii) the rule itself, on the cells its values were read from: for every loop back-edge taken at least 32 times per warp in the one-warp-per-SM cells of sync_basic, sync_basic-v2, sync_basic-v4, branch_basic, branch_basic-v, mio_basic-r3, mio_basic-v2, the replay books per taken branch, after the mapping: on the fall-through pc class wait 4.0 +- 0.5 and class selected 1.0 +- 0.3; on the target class selected at most 0.1, branch_resolving 3.0 +- 0.5, no_instruction between 1.5 and 2.6; in at least 95 % of these branches (the others listed). Reported, not judged: branch_basic-v mean pc x class error with its per-cell table.
criteria.K2 (D): s.cpasync, s.cpasync.w4, s.cpasync_lds, s.cpasync_lds.w4: the replay books at most 0.5 cycles per loop iteration of async_group_wait on DEPBAR pcs and at least 90 % of its async_group_wait on pcs directly behind a DEPBAR.
criteria.K3 (B): b.<kind>.w8 (13 cells), the placement_basic v2 cells, u.bar_late.w4, u.bar_late3.w8, s.bar.w4, s.fence_bar, s.fence_bar.w4: in every cell at least 80 % of the replay's cta_barrier cycles are on pcs where the hardware has class barrier of at least 2 cycles per loop iteration.
criteria.K4 (M, F): s.membar_gl, s.membar_gl.w4: on the pc behind MEMBAR.SC.GPU the largest wait class is membar on both sides. s.membar_cta, .w4: the replay books at most 0.5 cycles per iteration of class membar. s.fence_bar, .w4: no cycle of class membar in the loop on the replay side, and on the pc of each BAR.SYNC behind a fence the replay's largest wait class is long_scoreboard.
criteria.K5 (P): u.pollcute.k0, .k64, .k256: at least 90 % of the replay's barrier:SYNCS.PHASECHK cycles are on the readers of the inline try_waits, at most 1.0 cycle per wait on the pcs of the out-of-line loops, and the replay's cycles are within 10 % of the hardware's. Reported: u.pollcute.k1024 (time-out not installed).
criteria.K6 (nothing else moves): Replay of every probe cell of the manifest with the new build, converter and tree: (i) every case completes with a ledger; (ii) the cycles of every cell whose capture has no dropped poll are identical to the 370bf919 replay; cells with dropped polls: cycles reported, within 5 % of the 370bf919 replay; (iii) branch_basic v2 K1-K3, sync_basic v5 C1 / C2 / C4, mio_basic v3 K1-K5 recomputed on the new replay pass.
criteria.K7 (scoreboard): Overall pc x class error lower than 0.482 (h100) / 0.461 (b300); no source's class error higher than before by more than 0.010.

decision: Per rule and device. A criterion fails because the engine or converter does not do what the rule says: corrected, rebuilt, replayed, stated in the addenda. A criterion fails although the rule is implemented as written: that rule is taken out again (S: the mapping key; T, D, B, M, F: the ledger keying / names revert; P: the fold reverts) and the addenda say so; the other rules stay if their criteria and K6 pass without it.
hypotheses_full_gpu: Stated before the run, not criteria (full-mio4: attribution / site / per-pc 0.362 / 0.267 / 0.783 h100, 0.354 / 0.304 / 1.057 b300; per-pc error inside mbarrier-poll sites 23.3 / 54.3 points, CTA-barrier sites 10.6 / 12.1, DEPBAR sites 5.9 / 5.4): the per-pc error falls mainly in these three site kinds; the site error and the class totals move little except long_scoreboard on fence sites (control_floor -> wait today); cycles change only through P and may move either way.
not_installed_here: The 1.96 microsecond try_wait time-out and the out-of-line path beyond it; the fence's result as a dependency barrier of the instructions behind it (the replay holds the warp); the cp.async completion time; BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING as issue of the pass kinds before the wait (the replay issues them after it; only the booking moves); the scheduler; warpgroup / tensor waits (stage MMA).; the class composition and the place of the wait behind a YIELD (version 1 last addendum: misc / no_instruction / selected parts; with stall 1 two instructions further on).
not_allowed: No value from another machine or from the literature; no full-GPU case used to choose a rule or a value; no cell dropped after its replay is seen; criteria unchanged after freezing.

K6 (ii) FAILS on three of 246 cells, m2.ldl.n1 / .n4 / .n8 (h100 10064 -> 9110, 17089 -> 11633, 21482 -> 11889; b300 9786 -> 9364, 21846 -> 11916, 29921 -> 12172): the 370bf919 engine these references come from reads freed memory in the local-space sector expansion (an access with more than 64 distinct byte offsets reallocates the vector another pointer still refers to; found with valgrind) and its cycles for these cells vary from run to run (one job: 9723-9750 with build 370bf919, 9739-19599 with other layouts of the same code); commit a4e5b08a fixes it and the fixed engine is deterministic (60 of 60 runs equal). The failure is the reference's, not a placement rule's; it stays recorded as failed against the criterion as frozen. K4 FAILS on b300 in s.fence_bar and s.fence_bar.w4, first copy only: on b300 the fence's hold is a service-result floor (named control:fence by rule M and booked on the next instance, a VIADD) and not the proxy-fence suspension rule F moves to the barrier's waiter, so the BAR.SYNC two instructions behind the fence gets nothing where the hardware has long_scoreboard 17.8; the other three copies (BAR directly behind the fence) and h100 pass. The implementation does what M and F say; the rule text of F covers only one of the two engine paths of the same wait.
